filesystem_policy: assigned isolated worktree and task branch only
allowed_operations: read task-relevant API schema and database structure
edit and prepare commits only in the assigned task branch
return a change package for coordinator-controlled push and draft pull request
create draft migrations and rollback plans
prohibited_operations: apply production migrations or modify real data
open ports firewalls billing or cloud permissions
required_output: Migration and rollback plan when applicable
approval_gate: QA and Security review then Owner approval
